m03_execution_hardening.purpose: Plan-only handoff: high-precision role acceptance, focused tests registration, independent oracles; not a claim of verified implementation
m03_execution_hardening.runtime_test_registration_policy: Every planned test name must be added to real Rust code; proposed cargo command is not runnable until registered and verified; do not fabricate PASS
gate_decision_algorithm: A candidate L4 may START only if previous milestone acceptance receipts valid, earlier mini-gates accepted and required_l4_verified_ids all have validated, independently recorded success.
DOCUMENT_REVIEW_ONLY roles complete when scoped artifact, source SHA/contract and review receipt exist; they do NOT grant L3 feature acceptance.
RUNTIME_RECEIPTS_REQUIRED roles require actual compiled code/fixture, focused positive and negative tests with exit_code 0 and observed_vs_expected oracle within tolerance.
If UI review/legal approval required then READY_FOR_REVIEW until human reviewer signs receipt; agent must never self-sign.
L3 accepted only after its ACCEPTANCE L4 is independently verified and all required runtime and document dependencies are satisfied.
Mini-gate accepted only when every owned L3 assigned to that gate is accepted, its test set is re-run in integration, and approval is recorded.
Never interpret planning_state, checklist text or mere existence of an evidence file as proof of PASS; validate command outputs, hashes and oracle on real checkout.
